svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, #121212); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="mcp-access" name="MCP: AI assistants on the SEO tools"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" background="#ffffff" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;" value="MCP: AI assistants on the SEO tools" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="700" x="20" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="claude" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;" value="Claude (phone / desktop)
or MCP Inspector" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="210" x="20" y="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="consent" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Consent page on the site
(sign in as admin, pick scopes)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="230" x="330" y="60" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="admin" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="Admin MCP server
OAuth 2.1 + PKCE
switch ADMIN_MCP_ENABLED" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="230" x="640" y="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="scopes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;fontSize=12;" value="Scopes
seo:read, seo:flows,
seo:review:reject" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="190" x="950" y="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="never" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=12;" value="Never: approve, publish,
roll back, submit" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="190" x="950" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="revoke" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Settings -> MCP
lists clients, Revoke" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="230" x="330" y="200" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="readers" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=13;" value="Readers' assistants" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="210" x="20" y="330" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="public" parent="1" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=13;" value="Public MCP server
published articles only
switch PUBLIC_MCP_ENABLED" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="230" x="640" y="310" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" parent="1" source="claude" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="consent" value="add connector"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="consent" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="admin" value="token"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="admin" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="scopes" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="admin" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;dashed=1;" target="never" value=""> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="readers" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;" target="public" value="no sign-in"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e5" edge="1" parent="1" source="revoke" style="edgeStyle=none;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeColor=#555555;fontSize=11;labelBackgroundColor=#ffffff;dashed=1;" target="admin" value="revoke"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
